english.meaning: to wrangle or bargain; 有得掹 suggests there is room to patch things up
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Really? They’ve only fallen out. So there’s still a chance to patch things up, right?
exampleSentences.traditional: 係咩？都係交惡啫。噉應該都有得掹𠸏，呵？
